comment: Fixed order. A stage runs when every `requires` glob matches in the work dir and no `produces` glob does. Reordered 2026-09-09: cheap drafts, research and the price proposal come before the expensive media, so an item that cannot sell never costs a capture or a generation. 2026-09-13: `design` (product-designer) replaces `render`; the storefront is Etsy, so copy and publish stay disabled until they are rebuilt for it. 2026-09-17: design also requires `price.approved.json`, written when a person confirms or overrides the proposed price in the console (POST /jobs/{id}/price); nothing paid runs for a price nobody approved. A stage's `agent` overrides the department worker. Disabled stages are listed so the vocabulary is agreed before they exist. 2026-09-21: copy and publish are rebuilt for Etsy and enabled. `copy` (write-listing) writes the Etsy text and the social captions as one draft, which listing_copy.py checks and splits into listing.json and social/posts.json. `publish` has no judgement in it, so it is a `script` stage: run_intake.py runs publish_product.py itself and no worker is spent. It drafts, uploads media, activates the listing and sends the social posts; the person's approval of the sale price is the gate for all of it, and `publish.auto_activate` and `publish.auto_post` in store config hand either half back to a person.
